📖 How to use

  1. Choose your bet and press Deal.
  2. Hit, Stand, or Double Down.
  3. Beat the dealer without going over 21.
  4. Blackjack pays 3:2 — manage your bankroll!

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which actions can I take?

Hit (take a card), Stand (keep your hand), or Double (double the bet, take exactly one card).

How does the dealer play?

The dealer reveals the hidden card, then hits until reaching 17 or more.

What does blackjack pay?

Blackjack (Ace + 10-value) pays 3:2. A tie with the dealer is a push — your bet is returned.

How does the bankroll work?

You start with 1,000 credits. It persists while you play; if you go broke it resets to 1,000.
